fact: ANID says OTP authentication on the UIN is fully deployed and actively used, including through the one-stop service-public.gouv.tg portal, with remote API, mobile and USSD verification of the e-ID, banks and financial institutions served for e-KYC, and biometric authentication as the next phase.
title: A gateway to social and economic inclusion and public sector modernization
publisher: Agence Nationale d'Identification (ANID), Togo, for ID4Africa
